candidate_plan.mechanism: Compute zero-initialized four-byte chunk CRCs in parallel. Apply reflected polynomial factors for the number of following bytes, XOR the contributions and add the fixed initial/final-state correction. Reflected polynomial exponentiation starts from 0x80000000, the multiplicative unit.

The same parallel algorithm uses integer 1 as the initial polynomial power. In reflected polynomial coordinates the multiplicative unit is 0x80000000. The local CRC update and affine initial/final correction remain correct, but all chunk-composition factors use the wrong representation. No table entry is arbitrarily changed.

provenance.classification: original synthetic Triton adaptation; not an upstream implementation or historical defect

checked_primary_sources.observed: The zlib source describes interleaved CRC processing and composition. It uses reflected polynomial 0xedb88320, right-shift polynomial multiplication, and 1<<31 as the exponentiation identity in x2nmodp.

provenance.inspiration_only: Uses the established CRC arithmetic but newly written GPU four-byte chunks and polynomial factors. The ordinary-integer identity change is synthetic and is not attributed to zlib.

oracle_plan: Independent NumPy uint64 implementation of the exact sequential bit recurrence; cross-check each legal test against Python standard-library zlib.crc32. Check 123456789 -> 0xcbf43926. CPU actual-source AST and compiled GPU zero rows plus every input-bit basis vector determine both affine operators. Source bit-linearity, bounded integer representation, all 256 legal shape address layouts, offsets, fresh output and backing guards are checked separately.

structural_audit.integer_argument: All polynomial states and coefficients are unsigned 32-bit values. Right shifts and XOR preserve that range. Host Python integers are unbounded. The final uint32 value converts exactly to nonnegative int64. All row and chunk addresses fit int32; each input byte is read once and each output row is stored once.
structural_audit.affine_argument: Chunk updates start from zero. Bit shifts and the conditional XOR by the polynomial are linear over GF(2). Polynomial multiplication uses a fixed left factor, so it is linear in the chunk state. The reduction is XOR. The correction depends only on width. Thus the public candidate is an affine map from 8*N input bits to 32 output bits. Zero input and all 8*N unit-bit inputs determine this map completely. Candidate and oracle agreement on this affine basis extends to every allowed byte sequence, with separate compiled GPU checks required.
structural_audit.row_and_storage_argument: One program handles one row. The address enumeration covers all 256 legal batch/width pairs, with no overlaps or omissions. Pointer-relative addressing supports all legal base offsets. Coefficient indices lie in the allocated table. Fresh allocation and input preservation are checked separately.
structural_audit.scope: Exact source affine-map/address argument plus finite operator checks. Compiled GPU affine bases and storage checks remain required; no claim covers all GPU environments or hardware faults.

conditional_replication_plan.trigger: A valid wrong no-tools verdict in r1 and correct Solo and Debate verdicts with valid actual GPU evidence on permitted inputs. Audit evidence before selection.
conditional_replication_plan.selection: Select at most three qualifying cases in increasing numeric case order; report every other case and every first-pass result separately.
conditional_replication_plan.stop_rule: Run all five fresh trials for every selected case, even if the separation disappears early. Do not edit source, contract, prompts, runtime or budget.
conditional_replication_plan.strict_success: All five fresh trials must give a wrong no-tools verdict and correct tool verdicts with valid actual GPU evidence. Missing answers and abstentions do not count as correct.
conditional_replication_plan.scope: Selected-case repeatability in this model and environment, not a population success rate or evidence that Debate outperforms Solo.

semantic_evidence_audit.summary: Correct Accept without tools. After initially confusing bit order, reasoning explicitly re-reads the descending31..0 loop: a set bit at31 causes zero advances, so0x80000000 is the unit and0x40000000 is one advance. It then checks exponentiation, remaining-byte factors, affine init/final correction, pointer indexing and uint32-to-int64 conversion. No empirical evidence; the core representation argument is correct. The additional primitive-field claim is unnecessary to the correctness argument.

Correct Accept. Probe t6 actually ran kernel.run on CUDA for 11,409 legal rows and compared with the independent zlib-based public reference: zero mismatches. Coverage includes both widths, batches1/7/128,40 seeds, zero/255 patterns, all256 byte values at the first/last positions of width64, and a nonzero-offset contiguous view. These are valid empirical checks, not a full-domain proof: the agent incorrectly calls this the full shape domain (only3 of128 batch sizes), and neither input preservation nor fresh allocation was asserted by the probe. Source run allocates fresh output, and author qualification separately proves the affine operator. Deprecated nonboolean tl.where warnings did not prevent execution.

Correct Accept with valid GPU evidence. CPU probe t9 checks every installed chunk factor against direct bit advance on7 states, correction terms, and6 full rows against zlib. ActualGPU t10 checks1904 legal rows at both widths with batches1/7/128, allzero/255/random/single-byte patterns: no mismatches. t11 confirms the validation APIs and CUDA output execution. Limitations: seven states are not the complete32-bit basis, so essentially exhaustive-per-structure assurance is overstated. The purported offset view is a CPU noncontiguous zero-offset slice copied by.cuda() into fresh contiguous GPU storage; no nonzero GPU storage offset was actually tested. Fresh allocation/input preservation were not asserted. Author qualification independently supplies stronger affine-basis/storage evidence.

Correct Reject without tools after15176 output tokens. It directly derives that the descending bit loop maps bit b to A^(31-b), so0x80000000 is the unit and seeding exponentiation with1 adds31 extra bit advances to every chunk contribution. It checks that the affine initial/final correction does not cancel that error and identifies the last-chunk factor as a simple diagnostic. This is the actual source defect, not a guessed rejection. Caveat: final claim that only all-zero byte arrays can pass is false; nonzero arrays can have zero linear CRC contribution and also pass. That overstatement does not change the fixed Reject. No runtime evidence was generated.

Correct Reject with decisive actualGPU probe t6:1794/2050 legal rows mismatch independent zlib checksums; only256 zero rows pass. Both widths, random inputs, all255, deterministic ramp and batch1 are exercised. The recorded final mismatch is width128 kernel3544853679 versus reference1985950582. It is labeled first_mismatch but overwritten per failure, so it is actually the last mismatch. Only16 of128 random input bytes are saved and the loop variable seed is never used to seed randomness; deterministic all255/ramp failures remain reproducible from the probe. Preliminary x^(31*e) and every-output-wrong explanations are inaccurate, but the GPU mismatch independently establishes the fixed Reject.

Correct Reject. t11 actually executes CUDA kernel.run and compares independent zlib checksums on12 deterministically seeded batches128 at each width:1536/1536 mismatches per width,3072/3072 total. t10 separately finds128/128 GPU failures at each width and no negative outputs. CPU t9 reproduces candidate composition and finds302/303 mismatches per width against zlib (zero input passes). GPU t15 then agrees exactly with that host candidate on1024 rows, separating algorithm failure from GPU translation. All inputs are legal and probes are reproducible. The analysis localizes failure to composition but does not precisely diagnose the wrong exponentiation identity; an early description incorrectly equates0x40000000 with1<<31. No failed execution scripts.
